en: Geolocated postcards from Europeana. Data retrieved from Europeana. Geolocation process done at EPFL.

The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a grand city square with a monumental triumphal arch and an equestrian statue. The square is surrounded by classical buildings. The arch is richly decorated with sculptural elements, and the statue depicts a man on horseback atop an ornate pedestal. There is text printed at the top of the postcard.

The image shows a sepia-toned historical street scene viewed through a large stone archway with a decorative crest above it. People in early 20th-century attire are seen walking and standing along the cobblestone street. The architecture is distinctly Northern European, with gabled rooftops and stone facades. The text 'REVAL. GROSSE STRANDPFORTE.' is printed on the lower part of the image, and there is also vertical text on the right-hand side.

The image shows an ornate fountain surrounded by highly decorative wrought-iron gates set in a public square. The centerpiece is a sculptural group with classical figures and flowing water, framed by elaborate gilded gates with intricate designs and crests. The scene is surrounded by trees, suggesting it is outdoors. The postcard has a sepia tone, indicating it is likely vintage.

A vintage black-and-white postcard image depicting a grand neoclassical theater building, titled 'Le Grand Théâtre' in Bruges. The structure has prominent columns, arched windows, and elaborate architectural detailing. There is text printed in red in the upper left corner and lower left, as well as a handwritten name 'Jeanne' at the bottom.

The postcard depicts a picturesque town nestled at the base of a steep, rocky hill. Atop the hill is a prominent castle or fortress, surrounded by trees. The town below features a number of buildings with red roofs and a notable church with a bell tower. The setting is mountainous and lush, suggesting a location in southern Europe. The image is colorized in a vintage style, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The word 'Arco' is printed on the top right, and there is a publisher's mark along the left edge.

The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of a fortified building with multiple levels of wooden walkways and staircases attached to whitewashed stone walls. The roof is steep and covered with wooden shingles. The photo has a handwritten caption at the bottom left: 'Prejmer-Tartlau'.

A black and white photograph showing a historical street parade or religious procession. The participants are dressed in period costumes, some resembling Roman soldiers and others in robes, reenacting a biblical scene (likely the Passion of Christ, with a central figure carrying a cross). Crowds line both sides of a bustling city street, and there are many flags hanging from the buildings. In the background, a tall, recognizable medieval bell tower rises above the rooftops.

This is a colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a city with a prominent hill topped by a fortress or castle. The foreground includes green fields and a winding river flowing through the city. There is a bridge crossing the river, and the city is densely built around the hill. At the top, the text reads 'Graz von der Kanzel.'

The image shows a grand neoclassical building with a large dome and several smaller domes, adorned with statues and columns. The area in front is a landscaped public square with people walking and flowerbeds. The surrounding architecture is also historic, with another prominent building and a church spire visible to the left.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a tree-lined street with tram tracks and a pedestrian promenade. On the right, there is a statue on a pedestal surrounded by a small plaza. The surrounding buildings appear to be from the late 19th or early 20th century. The text 'Hirschberg.' and 'Promenade.' is printed at the top.

A black-and-white illustrated postcard depicting an ancient stone gate and surrounding buildings, with people gathered and walking in a lively square. The architecture is Romanesque, and the scene features a central arched gateway, known as 'Porta ferrea,' with several smaller structures and a columned kiosk in the foreground. The text at the bottom is in both Italian and Croatian, indicating the name of the city and the monument.

A sepia-toned, vintage postcard depicting the Brandenburg Gate, a neoclassical monument in Berlin. The image shows the gate with its iconic columns and the Quadriga statue on top. There are people and horse-drawn carriages visible in the foreground, and an old-style street lamp on the left. The postcard has text in the upper left corner.

The image shows a historic, ornate building with steep gabled roofs, brick walls, and multiple windows. There is a prominent exterior staircase leading up to an elevated entrance. The photo has a vintage, colorized appearance typical of early 20th-century postcards. At the bottom, 'Waaggebouw Nijmegen' is printed, identifying the location.

A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a picturesque canal scene in Bruges, Belgium. On the right is a large, ornate Gothic-style building with pointed towers and elaborate decorations, likely the Palais du Franc. The left side of the image shows a tree-lined street with two children standing near the water’s edge. Two swans are swimming in the canal. In the background, a small stone bridge crosses the water. The postcard includes French text at the top and along the left margin.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a public square in Bruges, Belgium. The foreground shows people in early 20th-century attire walking and socializing. On the left, there is a building with a sign reading 'MERCERIES'. In the background, a prominent medieval tower (the Belfry of Bruges) is visible. On the right, there is a grand, ornate building, labeled as the 'Hôtel du Gouvernement'. The postcard is captioned in French at the bottom.

A sepia-toned photograph showing a park with tall trees framing a view of a stone fortress wall and tower in the background. There is a circular feature (possibly a fountain or a garden bed) in the foreground. The postcard has text written in a white script at the bottom: 'Dubrovnik - Park Gradac.' and 'FOTO-BERNER 46.'

This is an illustrated postcard showing a scenic view of a city with a prominent hill in the background, topped by a tower or fortification. In the foreground, there is a large tree with spring foliage and wildflowers. The cityscape is depicted in soft pastel colors. The right edge of the postcard contains the printed text 'Vom Hofenhain' and 'Graz.'

A black-and-white photograph of a large, ornate church with a tall clock tower and spire, surrounded by trees and a white picket fence in the foreground. The architecture is neo-Gothic, and the church appears to be a significant religious building. The text at the bottom reads: 'Palanga. Kat. bažnyčia.'

A black and white image featuring a grand Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers, arched windows, and intricate stone details. There are statues along the upper façade, and the building is framed by leafy trees. In the foreground, people are sitting on benches in a garden or park area.

A black-and-white postcard image showing the entrance to a cobblestone street, viewed through an arched gateway. On the left side, there is a wall with a plaque and a bench. The street opens to a view of traditional Flemish-style buildings with steep gabled roofs, whitewashed walls, and some trees in the background. The postcard has printed text along the right edge.

A black-and-white historic postcard showing an interior hall with large columns, vaulted arches, and a beamed ceiling. On the right wall are several notice boards and framed documents. The hall is spacious and appears to be part of a significant municipal or historical building. The caption at the bottom reads 'Bruges -- La Salle des Pas Perdus de l'Hôtel de Ville.'

A black-and-white photograph showing a baroque church tower with a clock, looking out over a European cityscape with ornate buildings and a tree-lined street. The church's steeple is highly decorative and topped with a cross. At the bottom of the image, the text reads '33. GRAZ, STADTPFARRKIRCHE'.

The image is a colorized view of a city with a river winding through green fields and urban areas. A prominent hill rises in the center, topped with a fortress-like structure. The background shows low mountains or hills. The landscape is lush and developed, with a combination of older and more modern buildings. The word 'Graz.' appears in the top left corner.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a square with a prominent multi-story building, a clock tower on a hill in the background, and some hand-drawn red markings. The foreground includes a street scene with a horse-drawn carriage. There is handwriting along the borders and a printed caption at the bottom.

A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a natural grotto surrounded by lush vegetation and trees. In the center, there is a stone structure framed by large rocks. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th-century design. Text in both Portuguese and French is present, identifying the site as Camões Grotto. The bottom of the postcard contains additional printed information including references to Macau and colonial Portugal.

The image shows a colorized photograph of a grand Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers, lush greenery, a decorative street lamp, and people sitting on benches in a well-maintained park area in the foreground. The cathedral features arched windows and detailed stonework typical of medieval European architecture.

This is an image of a postage stamp featuring a ski jumper in mid-air, wearing blue gear, a helmet, and goggles. The background is a gradient of blue, and there is text referencing the Calgary 1988 Winter Olympics, along with the Olympic rings. The bottom of the stamp has the denomination '1,80' and the country names 'SUOMI FINLAND'.

A historic black and white photograph postcard depicting a large crowd gathered in front of an ornate building, likely during a public event or parade. The architecture features classical columns and statues. The crowd is dense, with many people wearing hats typical of the early 20th century. The printed text at the bottom provides context about the event, mentioning Strasbourg, General Gouraud, and the date November 22, 1918.

The image shows a historic street scene with early automobiles and bicycles, pedestrians, and a prominent clock tower in the center background. The buildings lining the street have signage in German. The postcard has a sepia tone, suggesting it is from the early 20th century. The text at the top reads 'Löwenberg i. Schl. - Markt.'

A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a large, ornate building with a prominent dome and classical architectural elements. The foreground shows a neatly landscaped area with stairs leading up to the building's entrance. The top right corner reads 'Zagreb' in red, with a handwritten date next to it. The lower left features the printed label 'Umjetnički pavillon,' and additional handwritten text is visible across the bottom.

The image is a black-and-white postcard showing the interior of a historical building with classical columns, display cases containing anatomical specimens, and ornate architectural details. The postcard appears to capture a museum-like gallery or conservatory.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a large, ornate church with a central dome and two tall clock towers with spires. The architecture is predominantly neo-Romanesque, and the building is surrounded by trees. The text 'ĐAKOVO' appears in the lower left corner.

The image shows a historical town square with a large church featuring a tall bell tower at the center. The square is busy with people and market stalls, indicating a lively marketplace. The architecture is typical of Central or Eastern European towns, with multi-story buildings surrounding the square. The postcard has multi-lingual text at the bottom, including Cyrillic, Latin, German, and Hungarian scripts.

The image shows a postcard styled as a front page of a historical newspaper called 'Diario de Noticias.' The content is in Portuguese, and the date at the top is '1903.' There is an illustration of a grand gothic building, likely a famous landmark, in the center, and a portrait of a man is overlaid on the right side of the card.

A vintage black and white postcard featuring a public square with a prominent statue at the center, surrounded by elaborate flowerbeds and historical buildings with stepped gables. The postcard references a horticultural exposition that took place in the square. Text is printed in French, giving details of the event and location.

A vintage postcard depicting a lively European town square filled with market stalls and umbrellas. The square is surrounded by multi-story classical buildings with shops on the ground floor. In the middle of the square stands a prominent statue or monument with several figures. In the background, on a hill, there is a large clock tower (Uhrturm) overlooking the town. The postcard has the text 'Graz - Hauptplatz' printed on it.

The image depicts a vintage, black and white postcard showing the facade of a large Gothic-style church with prominent pointed arches and high windows. The street in front is cobblestone, and a small cart is visible to the left. The church dominates the scene with its symmetrical towers and ornate architecture. The top of the card has the printed caption 'Bruges — L’Eglise St-Jacques.'

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a street scene with people walking and horse-drawn wagons. The central focus is on a large church with a distinct baroque-style dome and tower. To the right are grand, ornate buildings with statues on the roofline. The street is lined with trees and appears to be a quiet, possibly small-town area. The text at the top is in German and reads: 'Lobositz a. d. Elbe Kirche zu St. Wenzel.'

The postcard features a black-and-white image of a historical tower with a domed roof and small cupola, set amidst trees and above stone ruins or fortifications. The text at the bottom includes printed German phrases and handwritten notes. The printed captions read 'Gruß aus Graz.' and 'Liesl am Schloßberg.'

The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a formal garden with trimmed bushes and a white picket fence in the foreground. Behind the garden, there are large historic buildings with ornate windows, typical of European architecture. There is handwritten text at the top and bottom of the postcard. The printed text at the bottom references an exposition in 1901.

The image shows an old black-and-white postcard featuring a city park scene with horse-drawn carriages, a tall ornamental clock column, a small gazebo or kiosk, and a bandstand. The park is lined with trees and appears to be a lively public space. The postcard is captioned 'No. 20. La Coruña — Parque de Mendez Nuñez,' with additional text indicating the publisher and photographer.

The image shows a black-and-white, vintage-style postcard featuring a large, ornate brick building with pointed towers and decorative elements, situated alongside a canal. The left side of the image shows a row of trees along a cobbled street, and a small stone bridge crossing the canal in the background. The top of the postcard has printed text.

The image is a sepia-toned or black-and-white photograph of a historic fortified city gate with robust stone walls, a circular tower, and lush vegetation in the foreground. There is a bridge with a railing leading up to the main entrance. Above the arched gate, there is a small statue set in a niche. The word 'DUBROVNIK' is printed in block letters in the bottom right corner.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a historical building's courtyard, likely from a cloister or college. The view is framed by a large archway, looking onto a lush garden surrounded by a two-story arcade with arches and windows. In the background, elaborate towers and a clock tower are visible, indicating a significant and monumental structure. The text at the bottom references Santiago de Compostela and the Colegio Fonseca (Faculty of Medicine).

The image shows a sepia-toned view of a historical European square with a prominent Dutch Renaissance-style building with ornate gables and a staircase leading up to the first floor on the right. On the left, there are several traditional narrow houses with stepped gables. The caption under the image reads 'De Waag — Nijmegen.'

The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large, neoclassical building with a prominent clock tower and arched windows, located on the bank of a river. The building is connected to a multi-arched stone bridge with people walking across it. In the background, there are hills and early 20th-century urban buildings. The bottom of the postcard contains text in Cyrillic and Latin letters.

The image depicts a stylized monument with a statue of a knight or warrior in armor holding a sword, standing atop a pedestal. The monument is flanked by two other statues and features a prominent double-headed eagle with a shield and insignia. Below the monument, there is text in a Slavic script and a date. The background includes architectural elements, such as a clock tower and classical buildings, rendered in an art-deco style.

The image shows a colorized, vintage postcard depicting a scenic view with two people standing on a path surrounded by greenery. In the background, there is a prominent building with two towers and a dome, likely a religious structure, set against a pale blue sky. Printed text at the top of the card reads: 'Omstr. Nijmegen. Heilige Landstichting.'

The image shows an old monochrome postcard with a photograph of a grand Gothic-style cathedral with two tall spires, rising above traditional rooftops and round defensive towers. The postcard features handwritten script across its surface. The printed text on the top left reads 'Zagreb (Croatie)' and on the right 'Prvostolna crkva – La Cathédrale'. The date '6.6.1904.' is handwritten in the lower right corner.

The image shows the interior of a church with prominent Moorish Revival architectural features, such as horseshoe arches decorated with alternating red and white voussoirs. There are Christian statues, wooden pews, a central altar, and a religious mural above the main arch. The lighting is warm, and there is visible text on the walls near the altar.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing an old, large, and ornate building, likely of historical significance. The building has arched windows, a prominent archway, and a turret-like roof section, with bare trees lining the street. Several people are walking or standing on what appears to be a quiet road. The top right of the image includes multi-lingual text indicating it is an old-time view of Zagreb.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a public square with a statue in the center surrounded by trees and several people walking or standing around. Historical buildings are visible on the right side. The text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.

The image is a vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene with several boats on a river or canal, traditional Ottoman-era houses with red-tiled roofs, and a large historic fortress/castle in the background. People in period clothing, some wearing fez hats, are visible along the water's edge and in boats. There is a small bridge and a flag flying on the fortress. The postcard is colorized and has a nostalgic, early 20th-century aesthetic. The text on the postcard is in French and partially in another language.

A black-and-white postcard depicting the courtyard of a historic hospital complex. The architecture is medieval with pointed arches, brickwork, and steeply pitched roofs. There are people in period dress, including a nun or nurse, standing in the courtyard. The text at the top reads 'Bruges – La Cour de l'Hôpital St. Jean.'

The image shows a vintage black-and-white photograph, likely from the early 20th century, depicting a steam-powered boat docked by a waterfront. In the background, there is a large, ornate building with onion domes and a cross on top, which visually resembles Orthodox Christian church architecture. There are also other historic buildings and a figure walking along the shore. The boat bears the visible name 'S/S ARANDA YHTEYSALUS'.

The image is a vintage, sepia-toned postcard depicting a large Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers, each featuring a bell. There is a clock on the right tower. In front of the cathedral, a few people are seen walking in an open square. The text at the bottom identifies the building as 'A Sé (La Cathédrale)' in Lisbon (Lisboa), and there is additional publication information in French and Portuguese.

A black and white vintage postcard depicting a grand Gothic-style building complex with ornate stonework, pointed arches, and towers. The scene is framed by a wrought iron fence, and a man stands on the sidewalk in front. The left side shows a smaller, simpler building covered in vegetation, while the right side features an elaborate structure with arched windows and intricate details. The text at the top identifies the location as 'Le Musée de Dentelles (Gruuthuse)' in Bruges.

The postcard features a monochrome illustration of a tall, ornate gate tower with a pointed roof and clock face, flanked by leafless trees and some surrounding buildings. The left side of the card contains the illustration, and the right side is blank, likely for a message. The text 'St. Johannsthor in Basel' is visible beneath the illustration, and the word 'SEIDENGEWEBE' is printed below that.

A vintage postcard showing a large, open public square surrounded by historic buildings. In the center background is a prominent domed structure with a tower, likely a former mosque or religious building, now with Christian elements. The square is lined with trees, people, and horse-drawn carriages, suggesting an early 20th-century scene. The text in Hungarian at the bottom reads 'Széchenyi-tér, Pécs.' There is also publisher information in Hungarian along the left margin.

The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a grand, ornate building in an urban square. The text is in Hungarian and German, suggesting a bilingual region. The building is labeled as 'Pécsi Takarékpénztár palotája,' which translates to the Savings Bank Palace of Pécs. The architecture is elaborate, with classical details and a prominent roofline, indicating a late 19th or early 20th-century style. There is additional printed text on the left and top right sides in red ink.

The image shows an old black-and-white drawing of a historical building complex with arched windows and a round apse. The architecture includes Romanesque features, such as semi-circular arches and thick walls. There is a courtyard with a couple of figures in old-fashioned dress. The bottom of the image has handwritten or stylized text.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a busy train station platform with people walking and gathering around trains. The architecture in the background has a Northern European look, and the postcard features the printed text 'Hamar Station' at the top.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a statue of Albert Schweitzer in a small European square. The statue is set on a stone plinth inscribed with the words 'Eerbied voor het leven' and 'Albert Schweitzer'. The background features a decorative historical building with ornate details and gabled roofs, surrounded by other classical European-style buildings.

A black-and-white postcard depicting an industrial riverside scene with a tram depot (remise) and a prominent smokestack in the foreground. Several gabled buildings line the water, and railway tracks are visible. In the background, a city skyline with notable church towers rises above the buildings. The card features printed text at the top indicating the location and subject.

A multi-view postcard featuring four prominent historical landmarks. The top left image shows a large domed building in a city square with a fountain; the top right image features a Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a statue in front; the bottom left image includes a mosque with a minaret next to a pink building; the bottom right image shows a medieval stone castle wall with a round tower. At the center of the postcard is a coat of arms featuring a star and fortress motif.

A black-and-white postcard image featuring a panoramic view of a walled city by the sea, with stone buildings, a prominent dome, and fortifications. There are trees and a winding road in the foreground, and smoke rising in the background, possibly indicating an event or conflict. The lower left corner contains the caption 'Dubrovnik (Ragusa)'.

The image is a vintage, illustrated postcard with four main vignettes, each depicting a different landmark. The landmarks are labeled as 'KRONENBURGER PARK,' 'STADHUIS,' 'BELVEDERE,' and 'VALKENHOF.' The postcard has decorative pink flowers and a coat of arms. Prominently displayed is the text 'GROETE uit NIJMEGEN,' which means 'Greetings from Nijmegen.'

The image shows a sepia-toned, vintage-style postcard framed in gold. The postcard features several small vignettes of buildings and a larger central panorama of a town or city, possibly drawn or lithographed. There appears to be a lighthouse or tall tower in some vignettes, and the overall style suggests a 19th-century European setting. At the bottom of the postcard, faint text is visible, and below the frame is a label with the number 21.588.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting the ornate interior of a mosque, with a row of columns and arches and intricate decorative panels. A group of people is seated on the ground in the left background, likely engaged in prayer or discussion. There is also a staircase (minbar) visible, which is typical in mosques.

A vintage postcard depicting a public square with the German Fountain (La fontaine de l'Empereur Guillaume II) prominently in the center. The fountain is a domed, octagonal structure with columns. In the background, there are visible minarets and the large domed structure of the Hagia Sophia, indicating a significant historical and architectural area. People in historical attire are seen walking in the square. The postcard has a tinted colorization typical of early 20th-century postcards, and French text at the top.

The image shows a vintage-style postcard featuring a prominent baroque monument with several statues, likely religious, in a public square. There are people gathered around the monument, and a large building with green window shutters and a reddish roof stands in the background. The sky is blue with some clouds. The text at the top reads: 'Pécs. Szentháromszágszobor a főgymnasiummal.'

A sepia-toned postcard image depicting an old European street scene. Prominently featured is an ornate baroque building with a dome and statues, likely a historic church or religious building. The street has several people walking and there are old-style streetlamps. The background shows more domed architecture. The word 'Dubrovnik.' is printed at the top left, and a small number '724' appears at the bottom left.

The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a large, ornate building with domes and classical architectural features. There is a prominent clock tower in front of the building, with advertising for 'ELIDA.' A uniformed man stands in the foreground, and there are a few people walking around. The word 'ZAGREB' is printed in the upper left corner.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph featuring a grand building partially obscured by trees, with a flag atop the building. There is a person walking along a path beside a balustrade in the foreground. The structure is surrounded by lush parkland. In the upper right corner, printed text reads 'Bad Pyrmont Schloß'.

The image shows two male wrestlers in the midst of a wrestling match, with one athlete lifting and grappling the other. Both wear vintage wrestling attire: one in a light-colored singlet, the other in a dark one. The scene is set in an outdoor stadium with tiered seating in the background, sparsely occupied by spectators. There is a man in a hat and suit, likely an official or referee, moving towards the wrestlers. A sign marked 'C18' is visible near the center.

The image is of a decorated vintage postcard featuring an ornate floral Art Nouveau border with pink roses and heart-shaped leaves. Within the border, there is a black-and-white photograph of a square with a prominent domed building with a cross on top and a tall tower beside it. The square also contains a fountain or monument and several surrounding historic buildings. Hills are visible in the background. There is printed text in Hungarian on the left side and at the bottom of the photograph.

The image depicts a grand, ornate palace set in formal gardens with wide paths and symmetrical landscaping. The building has a distinct European architectural style, with a tall, tower-like corner and mansard roofs. The postcard includes multilingual text in French, Bulgarian (Cyrillic), and a Latin transliteration, indicating the name and location of the palace: 'Le Palais Princier d’Euxinograd' in Varna.

The postcard displays an old sepia-toned illustration of a cityscape dominated by a prominent hilltop fortress or castle, with a river and bridge in the foreground. The lower part of the postcard features handwritten script and printed text in German, reading 'Gratz im Jahre 1800.' The edges of the card are irregular and aged, suggesting historical value.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a large Gothic church with a prominent tower in the foreground, surrounded by a dense cluster of historic rooftops. In the background, a wide river flows through the town, with a multi-arched stone bridge visible crossing it. The opposite riverbank is lined with more buildings and greenery. The text on the postcard reads 'Pirna a.d. Elbe – Blick vom Sonnenstein.'

The image is a vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with four tall towers and a central nave. In the foreground, there is a statue of a man standing on a pedestal in a garden square, with benches and flower beds. The caption at the bottom is in Hungarian and refers to the location and the statue.

The postcard consists of three black-and-white photographic views. The top image shows a riverbank promenade with people walking and a covered wooden pavilion by the water. The middle image depicts a grand historic building, labeled as 'Realka - Realschule,' likely an educational institution. The bottom image shows a street scene with old buildings and a prominent tower, labeled as 'Bezanijska ulica.' The captions are provided in multiple languages: Serbian (Latin script), German, and Hungarian.

A sepia-toned image showing part of a historic coastal city with stone fortifications, a prominent round bastion, and a harbor filled with old wooden sailing ships. The foreground features leaves hanging from a tree, and a stone jetty extends into the water. The architecture in the background includes classical domes and stone buildings. The bottom left contains the printed text 'Dubrovnik (Ragusa)'.

The image is a black and white postcard depicting a canal lined with historic buildings on either side, with a church featuring a tall spire in the background. The architecture is characterized by stepped gables, typical of the Flemish region. There is some printed text in the upper left and right corners.

This is a vintage illustrated postcard depicting a large train station with a neoclassical facade, labeled 'GRAZ Bahnhof.' The scene includes two trams or streetcars on tracks approaching the station, carriages, and people walking or standing in front of the building. There is handwritten text in ink and pencil across the postcard, including a visible date '3.4.1901.' The bottom of the card credits 'Kunstverlag Rafael Neuber Wien.'

The image shows a black-and-white vintage postcard featuring a central street scene in a historic European city. Prominent is a stone bell tower on the left, with a view down a wide pedestrian street lined with old stone buildings and people walking. Hills rise in the background. The upper right contains printed text indicating the city and the name of the street, both in a Slavic language.

The image shows a vintage, colorized postcard depicting a grand neoclassical building with large windows, columns, and a prominent domed roof. Several people in early 20th-century attire are visible walking or standing near the building. The text at the top is in Croatian and reads 'Zagreb. Kr. sveučilišna biblioteka.' The setting suggests an urban environment.

The image depicts a cloister with pointed Gothic arches, stone columns, and an open courtyard with potted plants and tiled features. The architecture suggests a historical and religious building. The postcard is monochrome, indicating it is likely from the early 20th century. The text at the bottom identifies the location as 'THOMAR — Claustro D. Henrique.'

A vintage postcard featuring a monochrome (likely blue-toned) illustration of a large church with two prominent spires. The church is surrounded by trees and other buildings, and sits atop a raised area with a wall in the foreground. Below the illustration, there is printed text.

A vintage postcard depicting a panoramic view of a coastal city with a notable round tower on the right side, several buildings along the waterfront, and mountains in the background. The sky is tinted in pastel hues. The text is in French, and the image has a nostalgic, early 20th-century feel.

The image depicts a painted or illustrated rural European village set in a mountainous landscape. There is a prominent church with a tall steeple in the center of the village, surrounded by traditional houses with red and white facades. In the foreground, a river runs along the bottom edge, and a stone bridge or viaduct with several arches crosses the scene. The background is dominated by green hills and forested mountains.

A vintage postcard featuring a detailed black-and-white illustration of an ornate building with towers and domes, labeled 'Tonhalle' at the bottom.
